Weng.Modeler
Class DbEntity

java.lang.Object
  |
  +--Weng.Modeler.DbEntity
Direct Known Subclasses:
DbCommand, DbContainer, DbCurve, DbHole, DbPoint, DbSequence, DbTool, DbWorkplane
public class DbEntity
extends java.lang.Object

The class DbEntity is the abstract base class from which all other entity classes are derived. This class serves as a proxy to the actual database entity. Being an abstract class, you can not instantiate an instance of DbEntity.

Name

public java.lang.String Name()
Gets the name of this entity.
Returns:
(_name) system default names always start with the underscore character. Otherwise, the returned name is a user-defined name.

Name

public boolean Name(java.lang.String name)
Sets the name of this entity.
Parameters:
name - this entity's new name. The naming convention follows:
1) case is ignored,
2) the first character must be in [a-z]
3) subsequent characters must be in [a-z,0-9,_]
Returns:
(true) successful / (false) failed for because 1) the name does not adhere to naming conventions or 2) the name is already being used by another entity.
